title: Industrial Recrafted
description: A modern remake of an old classic tech mod.
body:
Industrial Recrafted is a tech mod, inspired by Industrial Craft2, adding various generators and machines like a geothermal generator, wind turbines, electric furnace, macerator and much more…

Alongside this there are also various other tools and items like nano and quantum armor, powered tools and rubber wood.

The mod doesn't use FE, instead it relies on EU to balance other mods around this mod.

Machinery and Generators include:

*   Electric Furnace
    
*   Macerator
    
*   Extractor
    
*   Compressor
    
*   Canning Machine
    
*   Recycler
    
*   Basic Generator
    
*   Geothermal Generator
    
*   Wind Mill
    
*   Water Mill
    
*   Nuclear Reactor (WIP)
    

With antimatter, teleportation, advanced machines and upgrades in the works!

Items include:

*   Fuel & Electric Jetpack
*   Nano & Quantum Armor
*   Electric Tools
*   Dynamite
*   Canned Food
*   Fuel Rods

The mod also adds Tin, Uranium and Iridium Ore as well as Rubber Trees to the world generation.
